text.p: Typhoon Beth, with 90 mph winds, is just off the northwest coast of Luzon Philippines. It is likely causing problems for shipping through the Luzon Strait and in the northeast South China Sea. Rainfall may also be causing local flooding in Luzon but this does not appear to be a widespread problem. Beth will move slowly towards the west during the next 24 hours and then more rapidly towards the southwest thereafter. Shipping in the South China Sea will be affectted through the weekend. The rain in Luzon will taper off and end as the typhoon moves away from the areas.

Hurricane Lili is causing strong winds and heavy rain in Cuba at this hour. We expect widespread flooding and mudslides to occur. Damage due to these floods may become severe. Winds may also cause problems with some gusts more than 100 mph possible. Lili should move off the north coast in several hours. The problems will then shift into the Bahamas islands. Strong winds and rough seas will be a problem through the south and east islands of Bahamas late tonight and during Saturday. Heavy rain and flooding may also impact some of the islands during this time.

Tropical Cyclone 04S is in the southern Indian Ocean near 12s/77e and will threaten shipping as it tracks southwestward with top winds between 60-70 mph during the next 24 hours, and weaker thereafter
Additional flooding may occur in southern Vietnam the next 12-18 hours due to the remnants of Tropical Depression Abel.
Strong winds and heavy rain should impact the New York City area during this weekend. This may lead to coastal beach errosion and could impact shipping, somewhat.
